message.content:
You are building SERVER & DOMAIN management features (per-server disk-usage graphs, server rename, and advanced domain functions: nameservers, transfer/EPP, WHOIS-privacy) for the Nxeon VPS hosting platform at /opt/nxeon. Three OTHER agents are concurrently editing OTHER areas of this repo — ONLY touch YOUR OWNED FILES.

## CODEBASE PRIMER
- Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Prisma. Server Actions in `lib/actions-*.ts` marked `"use server"` (only async exports).
- Prisma: `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. Client is ALREADY generated with NEW fields:
  - `Server` new: `label String?` (customer-facing nickname / rename).
  - `Domain` new: `nameservers String[]`, `transferEpp String?`, `whoisPrivacy Boolean`.
- Auth: `import { currentUser, requireUser } from "@/lib/auth"`. ALWAYS verify the resource belongs to the current user before acting (ownership check: load the server/domain by id AND userId). This prevents IDOR.
- Proxmox metrics: `import` from `lib/proxmox.ts` (READ it — do not edit). It has an API client and a node-aware `pveFor(node)` factory; Proxmox exposes RRD data via `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/rrddata?timeframe=day` returning arrays with `disk`/`maxdisk`/`mem`/`cpu` etc. Use read-only calls only. If a clean disk-series call isn't already available, add a small read-only helper for it in YOUR new file `lib/actions-server-extra.ts` (or a plain `lib/server-metrics.ts` you create) rather than editing lib/proxmox.ts.
- name.com registrar client: `import` helpers from `lib/registrar.ts` (READ it — do not edit) for domain operations. For nameserver update / transfer-unlock / WHOIS-privacy, call the appropriate name.com v4 endpoints; if a helper is missing, add it in YOUR new `lib/actions-domains-advanced.ts` using the same signed-request approach you see in `lib/registrar.ts`. If an operation isn't supported by the current registrar client, still persist the intent to the DB (`nameservers`, `whoisPrivacy`, `transferEpp`) and note it.
- Design system (globals.css): `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-danger`, `.input`, `.table-shell`. Dark premium theme. Charts (dependency-free SVG): `import { AreaChart, MeterBar, Sparkline } from "@/components/ui/charts"` — READ `components/ui/charts.tsx` for exact prop shapes. Primitives: `import { Badge, fmtMoney, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- READ FIRST: `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` and `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx` (you EDIT these), `app/dashboard/domains/[id]/page.tsx` (you EDIT this), `components/customer/MetricsPanel.tsx` (existing metrics pattern), and `lib/actions-server.ts` (existing server-action style to mirror).

## WHAT TO BUILD
1. **Disk-usage graph** per server: a `components/customer/DiskUsageChart.tsx` showing disk used vs total over time (from Proxmox RRD) plus a current-usage meter. Add a read-only API route `app/api/servers/[id]/disk/route.ts` (ownership-checked) that returns the disk series, and render the chart in the server detail (Metrics tab or Overview).
2. **Server rename**: `components/customer/ServerRename.tsx` (client) + a `renameServer(serverId, label)` action in `lib/actions-server-extra.ts` that sets `Server.label` (validated, <= 40 chars, ownership-checked). Show the label as the primary display name (fall back to `name`) on the server detail header.
3. **Advanced domain functions** on the domain detail page: `components/customer/DomainAdvanced.tsx` with (a) editable **nameservers** (list add/remove, save → `nameservers` + registrar call), (b) **WHOIS privacy** toggle (`whoisPrivacy`), (c) **transfer out**: reveal/request the EPP/auth code (`transferEpp`) and a registrar-lock note. Back these with actions in `lib/actions-domains-advanced.ts` (`"use server"`, ownership-checked).

## YOUR OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
- CREATE: `lib/actions-server-extra.ts` (`"use server"`), `lib/server-metrics.ts` (plain helper, optional), `lib/actions-domains-advanced.ts` (`"use server"`), `components/customer/DiskUsageChart.tsx`, `components/customer/ServerRename.tsx`, `components/customer/DomainAdvanced.tsx`, `app/api/servers/[id]/disk/route.ts`.
- EDIT (sole owner): `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx`, `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx`, `app/dashboard/domains/[id]/page.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
- NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, components/portal/Shell.tsx, lib/auth.ts, lib/db.ts, lib/proxmox.ts, lib/registrar.ts, lib/actions.ts, lib/actions-server.ts, lib/actions-domains.ts, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, or any file not in your owned list. (You create NEW `-extra`/`-advanced` action files instead of editing the originals.)
- Every server/domain action MUST verify ownership against the current user. Read-only Proxmox calls only.
- Do NOT run `npm run build`, `next build`, `prisma db push/migrate/generate`, or restart services. Do NOT git commit/push. No new npm deps.
- `"use server"` files export only async functions.

## FINAL REPORT
Return: files created/edited (one line each); how disk graphs, rename, and each domain function work (and which domain ops actually hit name.com vs are persisted-only); any INTEGRATION NEEDED; anything incomplete or that needs live registrar/Proxmox testing.

## Final report

### Files created
- `lib/server-metrics.ts` — read-only Proxmox RRD helper `serverDiskRrd(vmid, timeframe, conn?)`. Uses node-aware `pveFor()` when the server is pinned to a `Node`, else the default `pve` client. Returns `{ time, disk, maxdisk }[]`.
- `app/api/servers/[id]/disk/route.ts` — ownership-checked GET returning the disk series plus `planTotalBytes` fallback. Returns empty series (not 500) if the hypervisor is unavailable.
- `lib/actions-server-extra.ts` (`"use server"`) — `renameServer(serverId, label)`: strips control chars, ≤40 chars, empty clears the label, ownership-checked, audit-logged, revalidates.
- `lib/actions-domains-advanced.ts` (`"use server"`) — `updateNameservers`, `setWhoisPrivacy`, `requestTransferOut`. Contains a small local name.com v4 Basic-auth client mirroring `lib/registrar.ts` (those endpoints aren't in the shared helper).
- `components/customer/DiskUsageChart.tsx` — timeframe-switchable `AreaChart` (used GB vs total) + current-usage `MeterBar`, auto-refresh 60s.
- `components/customer/ServerRename.tsx` — inline edit-in-place control next to the header title.
- `components/customer/DomainAdvanced.tsx` — nameservers editor, WHOIS-privacy toggle, transfer-out/EPP reveal with copy.

### Files edited
- `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` — header now shows `label || name` as the primary title with hostname as a mono sub-line and a `ServerRename` button; added a full-width Disk usage card in the Overview tab.
- `app/dashboard/domains/[id]/page.tsx` — added an "Advanced" section rendering `DomainAdvanced` with current NS/privacy/EPP state and `registrarConfigured()`.
- `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx` — not modified; the disk chart lives in the existing Overview node, so no signature change was needed.

### How each feature works
- **Disk graph**: chart fetches `/api/servers/[id]/disk?tf=…`; the API resolves the server's node connection and calls Proxmox `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/rrddata` (read-only). "Total" prefers RRD `maxdisk`, falling back to the plan's `diskGB`. Current usage = latest non-zero `disk` sample.
- **Rename**: `renameServer` sets `Server.label`; the detail header renders `label || name`.
- **Nameservers**: on save, if the domain is ACTIVE and the registrar is configured it calls name.com `:setNameservers` (**hits name.com**); the list is always persisted to `Domain.nameservers`. Inactive/unconfigured → persisted-only with a note.
- **WHOIS privacy**: **persisted-only** to `Domain.whoisPrivacy`. name.com privacy is a paid add-on set at registration, not a free live toggle — the action records intent and returns a support note.
- **Transfer out**: calls name.com `:unlock` (best-effort, some TLDs can't unlock via API) and `:getAuthCode` (**hits name.com**), stores the code in `Domain.transferEpp`, and reveals it with a copy button. Without a configured registrar it surfaces any previously stored code or asks the user to contact support.

### Ownership / safety
Every action and the disk API load the resource by id and verify `userId === current user` (ADMIN allowed), preventing IDOR. Only read-only Proxmox calls are used. No forbidden files touched; no build/prisma/git commands run. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes clean (exit 0).
